intro.title: fr unit and grid
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple webpage layout using CSS Grid to arrange content into rows and columns. You will learn the 'fr' unit, a flexible measurement that distributes available space proportionally within a grid container. The main technologies involved are CSS Grid Layout and the 'fr' unit for defining flexible track sizes. By the end, you'll understand how to create responsive grid structures that adapt to different screen sizes.
intro.usecase: The fr unit is essential for creating fluid, responsive layouts in modern web applications. Developers use it within CSS Grid to build dashboards with panels that proportionally fill available space, such as in analytics tools or admin interfaces. It's also key for constructing complex forms with sidebars, main content areas, and footers that adapt seamlessly to different screen sizes. This approach ensures UI components like data tables, card layouts, and control panels maintain consistent proportions without manual pixel calculations.
